sourcePolicy: Every sentence is an explicit route record reviewed against current membership, titles, parent/child relationships, and the site-quality audit. Counts remain computed.

hub_coloring_pages.introduction: The complete library spans animals, characters, patterns, plants, food, vehicles, places, and seasonal designs.
hub_coloring_pages.scope: Use this broad destination when the subject is not yet decided; its narrower collections provide the more precise routes.
hub_coloring_pages.distinction: Unlike subject and style hubs, this route contains the complete approved printable inventory.
hub_coloring_pages.selectionGuidance: Subject collections narrow what is depicted, while style and audience collections change how the same kinds of subjects are presented.

hub_animals.introduction: Wild and domestic animals range from dogs and birds to reptiles, insects, sea life, and prehistoric species.
hub_animals.scope: The hub combines living-animal subjects with clearly labeled extinct-animal branches.
hub_animals.distinction: Choose Prehistoric Animals for extinct species or Sea Life for ocean-focused designs; this route keeps the complete animal view.
hub_animals.selectionGuidance: The child collections are the most direct way to narrow by species or habitat.

hub_anime_girls.introduction: Character portraits and scenes use anime-inspired faces, hair, clothing, and expressive poses.
hub_anime_girls.scope: This is a character-style collection, not a general fantasy or all-characters inventory.
hub_anime_girls.distinction: Choose Chibi for compact proportions or Fantasy for imagined creatures and settings beyond anime-styled characters.
hub_anime_girls.selectionGuidance: The inventory includes individual portraits as well as characters placed in decorative or scenic compositions.

hub_bakery.introduction: Breads, pastries, cookies, baking tools, and decorated baked goods make up this food-focused collection.

hub_bats.introduction: Bat designs include flying silhouettes, hanging poses, close views, and seasonal character treatments.

hub_bears.introduction: Bear subjects appear as standing animals, forest scenes, family groups, and stylized characters.

hub_bees.introduction: Bees appear in flight, on flowers, near hives, and in decorative insect compositions.

hub_beetles.introduction: Beetle outlines cover varied body shapes, patterned shells, close views, and nature settings.

hub_birds.introduction: Songbirds, water birds, birds of prey, and other feathered species appear alone or in natural settings.

hub_birthday.introduction: Cakes, candles, gifts, balloons, party tables, and celebratory characters define the birthday inventory.

hub_brachiosaurus.introduction: Long-necked Brachiosaurus designs show standing, walking, feeding, and scenic prehistoric poses.

hub_bridges.introduction: Bridge designs focus on recognizable spans, structural forms, crossings, and surrounding city or landscape views.

hub_buildings.introduction: Houses, castles, landmark structures, bridges, and other built places form this architecture-led collection.
hub_buildings.scope: The route groups structures rather than destinations, with narrower branches for recognizable building types.
hub_buildings.distinction: World Landmarks emphasizes named places; Houses and Castles isolate specific kinds of structure.
hub_buildings.selectionGuidance: Start with a child collection when the structure type matters more than the broader architectural view.

hub_butterflies.introduction: Butterflies appear with varied wing patterns, flowers, garden settings, and close symmetrical views.

hub_cakes.introduction: Layer cakes, slices, candles, frosting decorations, and celebration cakes fill this focused food collection.

hub_cars.introduction: Cars range from everyday road vehicles to racing, classic, futuristic, and character-styled designs.

hub_castles.introduction: Castle towers, gates, walls, courtyards, and fantasy or historic-looking settings shape this collection.

hub_cats.introduction: Cats and kittens appear in resting, playful, portrait, household, and decorative scenes.

hub_chess.introduction: Chess pieces, boards, matches, and symbolic king-and-queen compositions define this game collection.

hub_chibi.introduction: Characters and creatures use compact bodies, large heads, and simplified chibi-style proportions.

hub_chibi_dogs.introduction: Dog breeds and puppies are redrawn with compact chibi proportions and expressive faces.

hub_chibi_flowers.introduction: Flowers and floral arrangements use rounded, simplified forms and character-like chibi styling.

hub_christmas.introduction: Santa, reindeer, trees, ornaments, gifts, winter scenes, and festive characters fill the Christmas collection.

hub_christmas_dogs.introduction: Dogs appear with Santa hats, gifts, decorated trees, winter clothing, and other Christmas details.

hub_cows.introduction: Cows appear in pasture views, farm scenes, portraits, and friendly stylized poses.

hub_crabs.introduction: Crabs are shown on beaches, underwater, in close shell views, and as playful sea characters.

hub_cute.introduction: Rounded animals, friendly objects, expressive food, and gentle character designs share a deliberately cute treatment.

hub_deer.introduction: Deer appear as woodland animals, antlered portraits, family groups, and quiet forest scenes.

hub_detailed_for_adults.introduction: Dense line work, decorative scenes, patterned animals, floral arrangements, and intricate objects make up this detailed collection.
hub_detailed_for_adults.scope: This broad source collection contains the complete detailed-design set and now has accurate narrower children.
hub_detailed_for_adults.distinction: Mandalas contains records explicitly identified as mandalas; Geometric contains records with verified pattern or geometry wording.
hub_detailed_for_adults.selectionGuidance: Use a narrower child for radial mandalas or explicit patterns, or stay here for detailed subjects that do not fit either label.

hub_dinosaurs.introduction: Recognizable dinosaur genera appear in portraits, action poses, family groups, and prehistoric scenes.
hub_dinosaurs.scope: The inventory is the dinosaur-only portion of the broader extinct-animal collection.
hub_dinosaurs.distinction: Prehistoric Animals also includes mammoths, saber-toothed tigers, and other extinct subjects that are not dinosaurs.
hub_dinosaurs.selectionGuidance: Species hubs provide the narrowest route when a particular dinosaur is wanted.

hub_diplodocus.introduction: Diplodocus designs emphasize the long tail and neck in standing, walking, and scenic herd poses.

hub_dogs.introduction: Dog designs cover many breeds, puppies, portraits, active poses, and stylized or seasonal scenes.

hub_dolphins.introduction: Dolphins leap, swim in groups, surface near waves, and appear in underwater scenes.

hub_dragons.introduction: Dragons range from winged and serpentine creatures to armored, elemental, and story-like fantasy scenes.

hub_ducks.introduction: Ducks and ducklings appear swimming, standing, nesting, and moving through pond settings.

hub_dungeon.introduction: Stone corridors, chambers, gates, treasure, traps, and fantasy adventurers define these dungeon scenes.

hub_eagles.introduction: Eagles appear in flight, perched with spread wings, in close portraits, and over landscapes.

hub_easy.introduction: This collection gathers printable pages under the existing Easy label.
hub_easy.scope: Individual pages do not yet carry reviewed visual-complexity ratings or age-band labels.
hub_easy.distinction: The broader For Kids collection contains these pages plus additional designs.
hub_easy.selectionGuidance: Use artwork previews and subject collections to choose the page that fits what you want to color.

hub_elephants.introduction: Elephants appear alone, in family groups, walking through landscapes, and in decorative portrait treatments.

hub_fairies.introduction: Winged fairy characters appear in gardens, forests, floral scenes, and other magical settings.

hub_fantasy.introduction: Dragons, magic, mythology, dungeons, wizards, creatures, and imagined worlds form the broad fantasy collection.
hub_fantasy.scope: This route joins character, creature, place, and magical-theme branches under one fictional-world destination.
hub_fantasy.distinction: Fantasy Creatures narrows to beings, while Medieval Fantasy and Dungeon emphasize settings and story elements.
hub_fantasy.selectionGuidance: Choose a child collection for a known creature or setting; remain here for the broadest mix of imagined subjects.

hub_fantasy_creatures.introduction: Fairies, griffins, mermaids, pegasus, unicorns, dragons, and other imagined beings share this creature-focused hub.

hub_fantasy_dragons.introduction: These dragons appear in explicitly fantastic settings, magical scenes, and imaginative creature designs.

hub_fish.introduction: Fish designs include single swimmers, schools, reef settings, patterned bodies, and close aquatic views.

hub_flowers.introduction: Named flowers, bouquets, garden arrangements, floral patterns, and stylized blossoms make up this plant collection.
hub_flowers.scope: The route includes both botanical subjects and decorative floral compositions.
hub_flowers.distinction: Garden Flowers emphasizes outdoor arrangements, while named child hubs isolate lilies, roses, orchids, daisies, poppies, lotus, and forget-me-nots.
hub_flowers.selectionGuidance: Choose a named flower when identification matters or use the full hub for mixed arrangements and floral designs.

hub_food.introduction: Baked goods, sushi, cakes, snacks, ingredients, drinks, and character-styled dishes form this food collection.
hub_food.scope: The inventory mixes individual foods with prepared dishes and decorative food characters.
hub_food.distinction: Bakery narrows to baked goods; Sushi and Cakes provide cuisine- and item-specific views.
hub_food.selectionGuidance: Use a child collection for a specific food family or stay here to compare the broader range.

hub_for_kids.introduction: Animals and character-led designs make up this broad printable collection.
hub_for_kids.scope: Browse the artwork previews by subject; individual pages do not carry age-band, safety, or difficulty labels.
hub_for_kids.distinction: The Easy collection is a separate browsing path whose current inventory is almost entirely contained here.
hub_for_kids.selectionGuidance: A subject collection is more precise when the desired animal or character is already known.

hub_forest.introduction: Trees, woodland animals, paths, cabins, plants, and layered natural scenes define the forest inventory.

hub_foxes.introduction: Foxes appear standing, curled, running, in family groups, and within woodland scenes.

hub_garden.introduction: Garden beds, flowers, tools, paths, insects, plants, and outdoor arrangements share this setting-focused collection.

hub_garden_flowers.introduction: Flower beds, mixed blooms, pots, borders, and outdoor floral arrangements define the garden-flower subset.

hub_geometric.introduction: Explicit patterns, abstract arrangements, kaleidoscopes, fractals, spirals, and geometric mandalas form this corrected inventory.

hub_geometric_dogs.introduction: Dog portraits and silhouettes are built from repeated shapes, facets, lines, and decorative patterns.

hub_giraffes.introduction: Giraffes appear in tall standing poses, family scenes, close portraits, and savanna settings.

hub_griffins.introduction: Griffins combine eagle and lion features in heraldic poses, flight scenes, and fantasy settings.

hub_halloween.introduction: Costumes, pumpkins, witches, spooky characters, trick-or-treat scenes, and decorated settings fill this Halloween hub.

hub_hedgehogs.introduction: Hedgehogs appear curled, walking, holding small objects, and exploring garden or woodland scenes.

hub_hippos.introduction: Hippos appear in water, on riverbanks, in family groups, and as rounded character designs.

hub_holidays.introduction: Christmas, Halloween, birthdays, St. Patrick's Day, and other celebration-led designs meet in this seasonal hub.
hub_holidays.scope: The route groups events and holidays rather than a single visual subject.
hub_holidays.distinction: Each child collection isolates one occasion, while this hub is the cross-season overview.
hub_holidays.selectionGuidance: Choose the named occasion for a coherent set of symbols and scenes.

hub_horses.introduction: Horses appear running, standing, in portraits, with riders, and across open landscape scenes.

hub_houses.introduction: Homes range from cottages and town houses to stylized dwellings, exterior views, and neighborhood scenes.

hub_hydras.introduction: Multi-headed hydras appear in battle poses, mythic scenes, and detailed creature portraits.

hub_indoor_plants.introduction: Potted foliage, bamboo, palms, shelves, planters, and room-based plant arrangements define this indoor collection.

hub_insects.introduction: Bees, beetles, butterflies, spiders, and other small creatures appear in close views and nature settings.

hub_kawaii.introduction: Small animals, food, and objects use rounded forms, simple details, and expressive kawaii faces.

hub_knights.introduction: Armored knights appear with shields, swords, horses, castles, and medieval-fantasy settings.

hub_koalas.introduction: Koalas appear climbing, resting in eucalyptus trees, in family groups, and as friendly characters.

hub_lions.introduction: Lions appear in portraits, prides, walking poses, savanna scenes, and decorative mane studies.

hub_lizards.introduction: Lizards appear on rocks and branches, in close body studies, and with varied scales and tails.

hub_llamas.introduction: Llamas appear standing, in mountain settings, wearing decorations, and as playful character designs.

hub_mammoths.introduction: Mammoths appear with curved tusks, shaggy coats, herd scenes, and icy prehistoric settings.

hub_mandalas.introduction: The corrected mandala collection contains explicitly identified radial, floral, geometric, and Celtic-knot mandala designs.

hub_medieval_fantasy.introduction: Knights, castles, armor, banners, creatures, and imagined old-world scenes define medieval fantasy here.

hub_megalodon.introduction: Megalodon designs show the extinct shark in open water, near other sea life, and in dramatic close views.

hub_mermaids.introduction: Mermaid characters appear underwater, near reefs and shells, with sea creatures, and in decorative portraits.

hub_monkeys.introduction: Monkeys appear climbing, swinging, sitting in groups, and moving through jungle or forest scenes.

hub_moose.introduction: Moose appear with broad antlers, in forest and lakeside settings, and in calm standing poses.

hub_mushrooms.introduction: Single mushrooms, clusters, forest-floor scenes, patterned caps, and fantasy fungi form this plant-adjacent collection.

hub_mythology.introduction: Mythic figures and creatures draw from gods, heroes, monsters, symbols, and legendary scenes.

hub_ocean.introduction: Waves, reefs, shorelines, underwater landscapes, vessels, and marine life share an ocean setting.

hub_octopus.introduction: Octopuses appear swimming, resting on the seabed, curling their arms, and exploring reef scenes.

hub_otters.introduction: Otters swim, float, hold objects, gather in pairs, and appear along rivers or coasts.

hub_owls.introduction: Owls appear perched, flying, in close facial studies, and among woodland branches.

hub_pandas.introduction: Pandas appear eating bamboo, climbing, sitting, in family groups, and as rounded characters.

hub_pegasus.introduction: Winged horses appear in flight, among clouds, in magical landscapes, and in decorative portraits.

hub_penguins.introduction: Penguins appear on ice, swimming, in family groups, and in winter character scenes.

hub_phoenix.introduction: Phoenix designs emphasize sweeping wings, flame-like feathers, flight, and dramatic fantasy compositions.

hub_planes.introduction: Passenger aircraft, propeller planes, jets, and imaginative flying machines appear on runways or in flight.

hub_plants.introduction: Flowers, trees, mushrooms, potted plants, garden growth, and leafy arrangements form the broad plant collection.
hub_plants.scope: The route spans identifiable plants, decorative arrangements, and indoor or outdoor settings.
hub_plants.distinction: Flowers isolates blossoms, Indoor Plants focuses on potted settings, and Trees or Mushrooms narrow by form.
hub_plants.selectionGuidance: Choose a child when the plant type or setting is known; use the full hub for mixed botanical subjects.

hub_playing_cards.introduction: Card suits, face cards, decks, hands, and game-table compositions make up this playing-card collection.

hub_plushie_animals.introduction: Animals are rendered as stuffed toys with stitched details, rounded bodies, and soft character shapes.

hub_plushie_cats.introduction: Cat and kitten subjects use stuffed-toy proportions, seams, patches, and rounded plush forms.

hub_plushie_dogs.introduction: Dog breeds and puppies appear as stitched toys with soft shapes and simplified features.

hub_plushie_dragons.introduction: Dragon features are translated into stuffed-toy forms with small wings, horns, seams, and rounded bodies.

hub_plushie_triceratops.introduction: Triceratops designs use toy-like bodies, stitched details, compact frills, and rounded horns.

hub_plushie_unicorns.introduction: Unicorns appear as stitched toys with rounded hooves, small horns, soft manes, and compact bodies.

hub_plushie_whales.introduction: Whales use stuffed-toy shapes, stitched fins, rounded bodies, and simple facial details.

hub_plushies.introduction: Stuffed-toy animals, creatures, characters, food, and objects share visible seams and rounded plush forms.
hub_plushies.scope: This is a material-and-style collection that crosses many subjects rather than a single character family.
hub_plushies.distinction: Plushie Animals and the smaller species collections narrow by subject; Cute and Kawaii use different visual signals without requiring toy construction.
hub_plushies.selectionGuidance: Choose a subject branch when the toy type matters, or browse here for the widest plush-form inventory.

hub_prehistoric_animals.introduction: Dinosaurs, mammoths, saber-toothed tigers, megalodon, dodos, and other extinct animals share this broader prehistoric collection.
hub_prehistoric_animals.scope: The route includes dinosaurs and non-dinosaur extinct animals.
hub_prehistoric_animals.distinction: Dinosaurs is a contained subject branch; the additional mammal, bird, and marine records justify this broader destination.
hub_prehistoric_animals.selectionGuidance: Use Dinosaurs or a species hub for a narrower taxonomic subject.

hub_pumpkins.introduction: Pumpkins appear as harvest produce, carved lanterns, decorated characters, and autumn or Halloween arrangements.

hub_rabbits.introduction: Rabbits and bunnies appear sitting, hopping, in family groups, and among garden or woodland settings.

hub_reindeer.introduction: Reindeer appear with antlers, sleighs, Santa, gifts, and snowy Christmas settings.

hub_reptiles.introduction: Snakes, lizards, turtles, and other scaled animals appear in portraits and habitat scenes.

hub_robots.introduction: Nine distinct robots include mechanical characters, futuristic pets, cyberpunk forms, and toy-like machines.

hub_roses.introduction: Nine rose designs include blossoms, arrangements, decorative forms, an origami rose, and a ginger-rose interpretation.

hub_santa.introduction: The Santa set shows gift-carrying, waving, sleigh-side, and festive portrait designs.

hub_sea_life.introduction: Whales, sharks, dolphins, fish, octopuses, crabs, turtles, and other marine animals fill this ocean-life hub.
hub_sea_life.scope: The route is animal-focused, unlike the broader Ocean setting collection.
hub_sea_life.distinction: Ocean includes waves, vessels, and scenery; this hub stays centered on living marine subjects.
hub_sea_life.selectionGuidance: Species children provide direct access to a known animal, while this route compares the wider marine inventory.

hub_sharks.introduction: Sharks appear swimming, hunting, in close body views, and among reefs or open-water scenes.

hub_sheep.introduction: Sheep and lambs appear in pasture, farm, flock, portrait, and friendly character designs.

hub_sloths.introduction: Sloths appear hanging, climbing, resting in trees, and in patterned or character-like portraits.

hub_snakes.introduction: Snakes appear coiled, moving through habitats, in close scale studies, and in patterned designs.

hub_spiders.introduction: Spiders appear on webs, in close body views, in nature scenes, and in seasonal compositions.

hub_st_patricks_day.introduction: Shamrocks, leprechauns, rainbows, pots of gold, Celtic patterns, and festive scenes define this holiday set.

hub_stegosaurus.introduction: Stegosaurus designs emphasize back plates and tail spikes in standing, walking, and prehistoric scenes.

hub_sushi.introduction: Sushi rolls, nigiri, platters, ingredients, and character-styled pieces form this cuisine-specific hub.

hub_t_rex.introduction: T-Rex designs show large-headed predators in roaring, walking, hunting, and scenic prehistoric poses.

hub_tigers.introduction: Tigers appear in striped portraits, walking or resting poses, family groups, and forest settings.

hub_trains.introduction: Steam engines, modern trains, carriages, stations, tracks, and scenic rail journeys fill this vehicle hub.

hub_trees.introduction: Trees appear as individual forms, forests, seasonal canopies, roots, branches, and decorative silhouettes.

hub_triceratops.introduction: Triceratops designs emphasize three horns and broad frills in portraits, herds, and prehistoric scenes.

hub_turtles.introduction: Land and sea turtles appear swimming, walking, hatching, and in close shell-pattern views.

hub_unicorns.introduction: Unicorns appear in portraits, running poses, magical landscapes, and decorative mane-and-horn designs.

hub_vehicles.introduction: Cars, trains, planes, trucks, boats, and other machines for land, rail, air, and water form this transport collection.
hub_vehicles.scope: The hub groups vehicles by function and travel mode rather than visual style.
hub_vehicles.distinction: Cars, Trains, and Planes provide the strongest narrower routes, with Steam Train available beneath Trains.
hub_vehicles.selectionGuidance: Choose a transport branch when the vehicle type is known or use this hub to compare modes.

hub_velociraptors.introduction: Velociraptors appear running, hunting, in close portraits, and within group or landscape scenes.

hub_whales.introduction: Whales appear surfacing, breaching, swimming in groups, and moving through open-ocean scenes.

hub_witches.introduction: Witches appear with hats, brooms, cauldrons, cats, spell books, and Halloween or fantasy settings.

hub_wizards.introduction: Wizards appear with staffs, spell books, robes, magical effects, and fantasy landscapes.

hub_wolves.introduction: Wolves appear alone, in packs, howling, moving through forests, and in close patterned portraits.

hub_world_landmarks.introduction: Recognizable monuments, towers, temples, bridges, and natural landmarks are shown as place-specific scenes.

hub_wyverns.introduction: Two-legged winged wyverns appear in flight, perched, in battle poses, and in fantasy landscapes.

hub_zebras.introduction: Zebras appear in striped portraits, walking or running poses, herds, and savanna settings.

hub_dodo.introduction: The dodo set shows the extinct bird standing, walking, in profile, and in island-like settings.

hub_bamboo.introduction: Seven bamboo designs show stalk clusters, leaves, potted arrangements, and panda-associated scenes.

hub_steam_train.introduction: Steam locomotives appear with smoke, carriages, tracks, stations, and historic-looking rail scenes.

hub_birthday_celebration.introduction: This route repeats the celebration subset already contained in the broader Birthday collection.

hub_christmas_plushie.introduction: Stuffed-toy characters and animals appear with Christmas clothing, gifts, trees, and festive stitched details.

hub_halloween_costume.introduction: Costumed characters appear as witches, monsters, animals, and other dressed-up Halloween figures.

hub_summoning.introduction: Magic circles, invoked creatures, spellcasters, symbols, and dramatic ritual scenes define this fantasy theme.

hub_terrier.introduction: Terrier breeds appear in portraits, alert standing poses, playful scenes, and stylized character treatments.

hub_woolly_mammoth.introduction: This singular route repeats the woolly-mammoth subset already contained in Mammoths.

hub_saber_toothed_tiger.introduction: Saber-toothed tigers appear with long canine teeth in stalking, resting, and prehistoric landscape scenes.

hub_magic.introduction: Spells, enchanted objects, glowing symbols, magical creatures, and spellcaster scenes form this theme collection.

hub_ankylosaurus.introduction: The Ankylosaurus set emphasizes armored backs and clubbed tails in standing and walking scenes.

hub_trick_or_treat.introduction: Costumed visitors, candy containers, decorated doors, pumpkins, and neighborhood scenes represent trick-or-treating.

hub_lily.introduction: Lilies appear as single blossoms, bouquets, garden stems, and decorative floral arrangements.

hub_forget_me_not.introduction: Six forget-me-not designs show small clustered blossoms in stems, bouquets, and floral arrangements.

hub_mosasaurus.introduction: The Mosasaurus set shows the marine reptile swimming, hunting, and moving through prehistoric seas.

hub_plesiosaurus.introduction: Nine Plesiosaurus designs emphasize long necks, flippers, and movement through prehistoric water.

hub_pterodactyl.introduction: Pterodactyl-labeled designs show winged prehistoric reptiles in flight, perched, and over ancient landscapes.

hub_iguanodon.introduction: Eight Iguanodon designs show beaked herbivores standing, walking, feeding, and moving in groups.

hub_bulldog.introduction: Eight bulldog designs emphasize broad faces and stocky bodies in portraits and friendly poses.

hub_collie.introduction: Eight collie designs show long-coated dogs in portraits, standing poses, and outdoor scenes.

hub_cookie.introduction: Cookies appear as individual treats, decorated shapes, stacked assortments, and baking scenes.

hub_daisy.introduction: Ten daisy designs show open-petaled flowers in single stems, clusters, bouquets, and garden scenes.

hub_pteranodon.introduction: Six Pteranodon designs show crested flying reptiles gliding, landing, and crossing prehistoric skies.

hub_nigiri.introduction: Nigiri pieces feature rice and fish toppings in individual views, assortments, and sushi platters.

hub_orchid.introduction: Nine orchid designs show distinctive blossoms on stems, in pots, and in decorative arrangements.

hub_poppy.introduction: Seven poppy designs show open blooms, buds, fields, and simple floral arrangements.

hub_lotus.introduction: Six lotus designs show layered blossoms, leaves, water settings, and symmetrical floral views.

hub_palm.introduction: Six palm designs show fronds, potted plants, trunks, and tropical-looking arrangements.

hub_leprechaun.introduction: Nine leprechaun designs include hats, shamrocks, pots of gold, dancing, and rainbow scenes.

hub_salmon.introduction: Eleven salmon designs include swimming fish, close body views, nigiri toppings, and plated sushi pieces.

hub_gingerbread.introduction: Ten gingerbread designs include decorated figures, houses, cookies, icing details, and holiday arrangements.
